headline: Interior Ministry Puts Thursday Arrests at 1,949
deck: The Guardian attributed the Thursday count to lycée students aged 15 to 18, part of nearly 3,000 held since the protests began. The BBC put injured officers at 305; the government later called the demonstrations urban violence.
body: France's interior ministry counted **1,949** arrests on Thursday, a figure the Guardian and the BBC both attributed to the ministry. [E1][E2] On the Guardian's ministry sentence those detentions were lycée students aged 15 to 18, and nearly **3,000** lycée students have been held since the protests began. [E1]
BBC reporting of the same ministry figure called them people arrested, not lycée students. [E2] The Thursday number matches; the category does not.
Injured police officers stood at **305** on that Thursday count, the BBC reported, in the same ministry sentence as the 1,949 arrests. [E2]

The Guardian wrote that more than 300 police and dozens of firefighters, teachers and pupils have been injured. [E3] The BBC's Thursday count is officers only; the Guardian's includes firefighters, teachers and pupils and does not name that day. [E2][E3]
The government said afterwards that the student-led demonstrations had descended into "urban violence", the BBC reported. [E4]
